dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、マンダム」
dialogues.en:
"And the temperature's perfect. The wind's soft. Cherry
blossom petals are dancing in the air and spring's singing
at the lives on this earth."
dialogues.text:
"And the temperature's perfect. The wind's soft. Cherry
blossom petals are dancing in the air and spring's singing
at the lives on this earth."

dialogues.jp: 意訳すると、本日は平和だって事だ。
dialogues.en:
"Today, there must be no car accident, theft or quarrel
between wives and husbands. Grandpas and grandmas who died
by choking on candies are smiling from heaven."
dialogues.text:
"Today, there must be no car accident, theft or quarrel
between wives and husbands. Grandpas and grandmas who died
by choking on candies are smiling from heaven."

dialogues.jp: 「｛まぶ／眩｝しいくらい、天気がいい」

「すごしやすい気温だ。風も穏やか。桜の花び
　らが緩やかに舞い、春はその生命を｛おうか／謳歌｝して
　いる」

「交通事故もひったくりも多分ゼロで、夫婦喧
　嘩だって仲直りしちゃうはず」
dialogues.en:
On such a perfect Sunday, I'm doing grocery shopping on a
high street.
dialogues.text:
On such a perfect Sunday, I'm doing grocery shopping on a
high street.

dialogues.en: "Well? What's next to buy?"
dialogues.text: "Well? What's next to buy?"

dialogues.en: I looked at the memo Yoriko-san gave me.
dialogues.text: I looked at the memo Yoriko-san gave me.

dialogues.jp:
そんないい日、せっかくの日曜だってのに、街
の商店街なんぞで、日用品を買っている俺。
dialogues.en:
"A new filter for the vacuum cleaner. She does notice
details."
dialogues.text:
"A new filter for the vacuum cleaner. She does notice
details."

dialogues.jp: 「ええと？　お次は何を買えばいいんだ？」
dialogues.en:
I pick up the heavy grocery bag once more and walk toward a
department store. The store I'm at didn't have the filters.
dialogues.text:
I pick up the heavy grocery bag once more and walk toward a
department store. The store I'm at didn't have the filters.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんからもらったメモを読む。
dialogues.en:
I walk through people. I think I'm starting to fit into this
high street.
dialogues.text:
I walk through people. I think I'm starting to fit into this
high street.

dialogues.jp:
「掃除機の中の紙袋、か。しかし、また細かい
　所に気が付くよな……」
dialogues.en:
Since the incident of last night, Yoriko-san has started to
act more like a maid.
dialogues.text:
Since the incident of last night, Yoriko-san has started to
act more like a maid.

dialogues.jp:
ズシリと重たいビニール袋を握り直し、デパー
トへ向かう。これは、スーパーでは売ってない
品だった。
dialogues.en:
She does cooking, laundry, cleaning, and everything around
the house now.
dialogues.text:
She does cooking, laundry, cleaning, and everything around
the house now.

dialogues.jp:
人を縫うようにして歩く。この商店街も、割と
馴染みになってしまったような気がする。
dialogues.en:
She doesn't mess up any more like she used to. She's been
great.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't mess up any more like she used to. She's been
great.

dialogues.jp:
一昨日の一件以来、頼子さんは急にメイドさん
らしくなってきた。
dialogues.en:
"Nemu...... there is no longer a place for you to come
back."
dialogues.text:
"Nemu...... there is no longer a place for you to come
back."

dialogues.jp:
炊事、洗濯、掃除。家の中のことを、なにくれ
と切り回すようになったのだ。
dialogues.en:
If she heard me saying this, she'd probably punch me in the
head and send me into a coma for 3 days.
dialogues.text:
If she heard me saying this, she'd probably punch me in the
head and send me into a coma for 3 days.

dialogues.jp:
初めの内にあった、ちょっとした失敗なんかも、
ほとんど見られなくなった。立派なものだ。
dialogues.en:
"If Yoriko-san could do the shopping...... she could be a
real maid......"
dialogues.text:
"If Yoriko-san could do the shopping...... she could be a
real maid......"

dialogues.jp:
「ふ、音夢よ……。もはや、お前の帰る場所は
　ないぞ」
dialogues.en:
She gave me this shopping list with an apologetic look.
She's been a great maid so far but she still doesn't want to
go outside.
dialogues.text:
She gave me this shopping list with an apologetic look.
She's been a great maid so far but she still doesn't want to
go outside.

dialogues.jp:
もし、本人に聞かれたら、三日は｛こんとう／昏倒｝しそうな
パンチを喰らうだろう呟きをもらす。
dialogues.en:
"It would be really nice if we could both go shopping
together......"
dialogues.text:
"It would be really nice if we could both go shopping
together......"

dialogues.jp:
「実際これで、買い物がきちんと出来たら……
　正真正銘のメイドさんだよな……」
dialogues.en:
I imagine us walking together on such a beautiful day like
this.
dialogues.text:
I imagine us walking together on such a beautiful day like
this.

dialogues.jp: 申し訳なさそうな顔でメモを渡してきた。

メイドさんとして板に付いてきた頼子さんも、
未だ外には出たがらない。

「二人連れだったら、買い物もずっと楽しくな
　るんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "......I like it. I like it very much."
dialogues.text: "......I like it. I like it very much."

dialogues.jp:
二人肩を並べて、こんないい日に外を歩いてい
る姿を想像する。
dialogues.en:
It would be better if she wore something other than the maid
costume, though.
dialogues.text:
It would be better if she wore something other than the maid
costume, though.

dialogues.en:
"Anyway, it's not good for her that she can't go
outside......"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, it's not good for her that she can't go
outside......"

dialogues.en:
I've been thinking about this problem because this might be
a very sensitive issue.
dialogues.text:
I've been thinking about this problem because this might be
a very sensitive issue.

dialogues.jp: 「……いい。それも、すごく」
dialogues.en: But I don't think I can keep ignoring it, either.
dialogues.text: But I don't think I can keep ignoring it, either.

dialogues.jp: メイド服は、ちくっと微妙な気もするが。
dialogues.en: "......I can do this!"
dialogues.text: "......I can do this!"

dialogues.jp: 「何にせよ、外に出られないのはマズイよな」
dialogues.en: Looking at the beautiful blue sky, I make a firm resolution.
dialogues.text: Looking at the beautiful blue sky, I make a firm resolution.

dialogues.jp:
どうしたものか、迷っていた問題だった。それ
は腫れ物であるのかもしれないのだ。
dialogues.en:
On such a perfect day as this, a complicated problem might
be able to be solved.
dialogues.text:
On such a perfect day as this, a complicated problem might
be able to be solved.

dialogues.jp: けど、まあ、触れずには済ませられないだろう。
dialogues.en:
"I ask to take her out to dinner tonight and see how she
reacts......"
dialogues.text:
"I ask to take her out to dinner tonight and see how she
reacts......"

dialogues.en: Smack!
dialogues.text: Smack!

dialogues.jp: 気持ちのいい青空を見つめつつ決心を固める。

こんないい日なら、やっかいな問題も簡単に解
決してしまうかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
I see white stars dancing in front of my eyes. The thing
that appeared in front of me is...
dialogues.text:
I see white stars dancing in front of my eyes. The thing
that appeared in front of me is...

dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、夕飯にファミレスへ誘うフリを
　して、反応を──」
dialogues.en: It's a lamppost.
dialogues.text: It's a lamppost.

dialogues.jp: ガンッ！！
dialogues.en: "I'm home!"
dialogues.text: "I'm home!"

dialogues.en: Patter-patter-patter...
dialogues.text: Patter-patter-patter...

dialogues.jp:
目の前を白い星がチカチカ舞う。その向こうに
立ち現れたのは──、
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 電柱だった。
dialogues.en: I put the heavy bag on the floor.
dialogues.text: I put the heavy bag on the floor.

dialogues.jp: 「ただいま〜」
dialogues.en:
She doesn't even take a look at the bag but keeps staring at
my face.
dialogues.text:
She doesn't even take a look at the bag but keeps staring at
my face.

dialogues.jp: ぱたぱたぱた……。
dialogues.en:
She's staring at me as if I was a captured alien, and I cock
my head in question.
dialogues.text:
She's staring at me as if I was a captured alien, and I cock
my head in question.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お帰りなさい──え？」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あのぅ……」
dialogues.en: "Yo-You are......"
dialogues.text: "Yo-You are......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "You are...... bleeding from your forehead."
dialogues.text: "You are...... bleeding from your forehead."

dialogues.jp:
言いながら、ぱんぱんに膨らんだビニール袋を
上がり｛かまち／框｝に下ろす。

荷物には目もくれず、頼子さんは俺の顔をじっ
と見つめている。
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.jp:
まるで釣り上げられた宇宙人を見るような目に、
俺は首を傾げた。
dialogues.en: "Oh, no. It's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Oh, no. It's nothing."

dialogues.en:
On the way back home, many people glanced at me. I thought
it was just because I'm a good looking man. Now I feel
stupid.
dialogues.text:
On the way back home, many people glanced at me. I thought
it was just because I'm a good looking man. Now I feel
stupid.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What? What? What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What? What? What happened?"

dialogues.jp: 何故か、申し訳なさそうに顔を伏せる。
dialogues.en: "Ah, it's a long story."
dialogues.text: "Ah, it's a long story."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おでこに血が……付いてます」
dialogues.en: "A-Anyway, let's clean it up......"
dialogues.text: "A-Anyway, let's clean it up......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I think we have an emergency box somewhere."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I think we have an emergency box somewhere."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。納得」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「な、納得ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you...... want me to do it softer......?"
dialogues.text: "Do you...... want me to do it softer......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、こっちの話」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
道理で、道行く人からちろちろ見られると思っ
た。俺ってもしや男前？　などと内心でほくそ
笑んでいたのが｛アホ／阿呆｝のようだ。
dialogues.en:
The strong pain on my forehead starts to go away a little,
and my stiff body starts to relax in return.
dialogues.text:
The strong pain on my forehead starts to go away a little,
and my stiff body starts to relax in return.

dialogues.jp: 「ぐはっ、しかし、血が出ていたとはっ」
dialogues.en:
After we looked through the entire house as if we were kids
trying to find treasure, we finally found the emergency box.
dialogues.text:
After we looked through the entire house as if we were kids
trying to find treasure, we finally found the emergency box.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　え？　やっぱり、驚きなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "How do you feel now......?"
dialogues.text: "How do you feel now......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あいやいや、こっちの話」
dialogues.en: "Better. It doesn't hurt so much any more."
dialogues.text: "Better. It doesn't hurt so much any more."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「と、とにかく、その……消毒を……」
dialogues.en: "The wound's not so deep...... I'm relieved."
dialogues.text: "The wound's not so deep...... I'm relieved."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん。たぶん、どっかに救急箱があったはず」
dialogues.en:
She's really relieved from her heart as if my face were
hers. I'm happy to touch her kindness.
dialogues.text:
She's really relieved from her heart as if my face were
hers. I'm happy to touch her kindness.

dialogues.en: (Anyway, this is...... embarrassing...)
dialogues.text: (Anyway, this is...... embarrassing...)

dialogues.en:
I'm sitting on a chair and Yoriko-san is stooping to clean
my forehead.
dialogues.text:
I'm sitting on a chair and Yoriko-san is stooping to clean
my forehead.

dialogues.en: So that means her breasts are right in front of my eyes.
dialogues.text: So that means her breasts are right in front of my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、いたたた……」
dialogues.en:
I can easily see her cleavage by the way she bends forward
with her open-front maid uniform. The thought of it make my
body boil.
dialogues.text:
I can easily see her cleavage by the way she bends forward
with her open-front maid uniform. The thought of it make my
body boil.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ご、ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: (......I want to touch it.)
dialogues.text: (......I want to touch it.)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その、もっと、優しくした方がいいですか？」
dialogues.en:
The primitive desire builds a dangerous desire in my right
hand.
dialogues.text:
The primitive desire builds a dangerous desire in my right
hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん、出来れば」
dialogues.en:
They look so soft...... and big...... I want to abandon
myself to pleasure!
dialogues.text:
They look so soft...... and big...... I want to abandon
myself to pleasure!

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "......Junichi-san...... Junichi-san?"
dialogues.text: "......Junichi-san...... Junichi-san?"

dialogues.jp:
額の刺激的な痛みが、少し退く。｛こわば／強張｝っていた
身体に、ややリラックスが戻ってくる。
dialogues.en: "......Ah! Wh-What? What did you say?"
dialogues.text: "......Ah! Wh-What? What did you say?"

dialogues.jp:
探険ぼくの町ってな感じで、家の中を引っかき
回した末、やっと救急箱を見つけたのだ。
dialogues.en:
I feel like she read through my heart, so I put my right
hand between my thighs so that it won't have its own will
again...
dialogues.text:
I feel like she read through my heart, so I put my right
hand between my thighs so that it won't have its own will
again...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「このくらいで……どうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, why did you...... get hurt......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, why did you...... get hurt......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん。痛みの喉元は過ぎた感じ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I was walking back home, minding my own business, and I
hit a lamppost."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I was walking back home, minding my own business, and I
hit a lamppost."

dialogues.jp:
まるで自分の顔のことのように、心の底からの
安堵をもらす。そんな気遣いが、やけに嬉しい。
dialogues.en: I don't tell her what exactly I was thinking about.
dialogues.text: I don't tell her what exactly I was thinking about.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、その……どうして、こんな傷を……？」
dialogues.en: "A lamppost...... Please be careful next time."
dialogues.text: "A lamppost...... Please be careful next time."

dialogues.jp:
練っていた｛しんりょえんぼう／深慮遠謀｝という名のファミレス計画
は、もちろん伏せる。
dialogues.en:
I feel her breath on my forehead when she softly laughs, and
she put gauze pads on there.
dialogues.text:
I feel her breath on my forehead when she softly laughs, and
she put gauze pads on there.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「電柱……。もう、気をつけて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "That's it......"
dialogues.text: "That's it......"

dialogues.jp:
クスッという、こそばゆい吐息が額に当たり、
ガーゼのような物が貼られた。
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「消毒……終わりです」
dialogues.en: "I'm relieved you didn't break a bone......"
dialogues.text: "I'm relieved you didn't break a bone......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さんきゅ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you're overreacting."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you're overreacting."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「骨とかは無事みたいで……良かったです」
dialogues.en:
I give a wry smile. Then Yoriko makes an angry face for a
change and says,
dialogues.text:
I give a wry smile. Then Yoriko makes an angry face for a
change and says,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「大げさだって」
dialogues.en: "No, I am not overreacting......"
dialogues.text: "No, I am not overreacting......"

dialogues.jp:
苦笑いを浮かべる。すると頼子さんは、珍しく
怒ったような顔をして、
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'll be careful."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'll be careful."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そんな事、ありませんよ……」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、気をつけるよ」
dialogues.en:
So, she wants me to be careful with lampposts, huh? That's
such a pinpoint warning...
dialogues.text:
So, she wants me to be careful with lampposts, huh? That's
such a pinpoint warning...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "It's already lunch time now. Ah...... are you hungry?"
dialogues.text: "It's already lunch time now. Ah...... are you hungry?"

dialogues.jp:
しかし、電柱に気をつけるってのも、ピンポイ
ントすぎる注意報ではあるな。
dialogues.en: I nod and Yoriko smiles.
dialogues.text: I nod and Yoriko smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あの、もうお昼です。その……お腹、空きま
　せんか？」
dialogues.en: "I'm thinking of making lasagna."
dialogues.text: "I'm thinking of making lasagna."

dialogues.jp: 頷くと、頼子さんはにっこり微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: "Lasagna? It sounds very difficult to cook. Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Lasagna? It sounds very difficult to cook. Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、ラザニアを作ろうと思うんです」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes...... I think so......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes...... I think so......"

dialogues.jp:
口調は頼りないが、ほのかな自信が見て取れた。
比較対象を音夢におけば、驚異的なまでの上達
ぶりだ。
dialogues.en:
She sounds unconvincing but I can sense a slight confidence
in her. Compared to Nemu, she's learning fast.
dialogues.text:
She sounds unconvincing but I can sense a slight confidence
in her. Compared to Nemu, she's learning fast.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「前に、お店のを買ってきていただいた時、美
　味しかったので……」
dialogues.en:
"When you bought lasagna for me from a convenience store
last time, I liked it..."
dialogues.text:
"When you bought lasagna for me from a convenience store
last time, I liked it..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「自分でも作ってみたいと、そう思ったんです」
dialogues.en: "So I wanted to try to cook it."
dialogues.text: "So I wanted to try to cook it."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、楽しみに待ってるよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, then I'm looking forward to it."
dialogues.text: "Well, then I'm looking forward to it."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
満点な笑顔で頷くと、頼子さんは台所へと消え
ていったのだった。
dialogues.en: She nods with a big smile and walks to the kitchen.
dialogues.text: She nods with a big smile and walks to the kitchen.

dialogues.jp: ◆メイドとしての成長◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 食材を買って家に戻った。
dialogues.en: It means today is a peaceful day.
dialogues.text: It means today is a peaceful day.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さん、今日はラザニアを作ってくれるらし
い。凄い料理の上達ぶりだ。
dialogues.en: "The weather's wonderful."
dialogues.text: "The weather's wonderful."
